description: Endpoints that forward requests to a paid AI model with the owner's key and never check the caller: a Lovable AI-gateway edge function (with verify_jwt = true, which the public anon key passes), a rate-limited Anthropic edge function (medium, not high), a Next.js route using the OpenAI SDK, a TanStack Start server function using the Vercel AI SDK, and an Express route that hands off to a same-file helper.
